tasks.name: Technology Radar
tasks.objective: Produce the Technology Radar for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every finding labelled adopt, trial, assess or hold
Each finding carries a source URL and access date
Licence and platform implications stated for anything shippable
A stated relevance to this project, not general commentary

tasks.name: Technique Evaluation
tasks.objective: Produce the Technique Evaluation for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: The technique is tried in a minimal reproducible test, not summarised
Measured cost or quality result attached where measurable
Recommendation given with the alternative it replaces

tasks.name: Adoption Proposal
tasks.objective: Produce the Adoption Proposal for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Owner department named for the adopted technique
Migration steps and rollback path written
Expected benefit stated in measurable terms
Studio Director decision recorded in the decision log
